headline: Ben really felt like an extension of our team.
quote: Ben fit seamlessly into our existing content processes and was quick to adapt to our internal workflow and project management processes. He was flexible with workload, taking on content for a variety of client accounts across marketing, HR, logistics, finance and customer service with minimal guidance from our team. He was always proactive about communicating on outstanding and upcoming pieces and really felt like an extension of our team. I'd be happy to work with him again in the future. You should too!
name: Grace Williams
